# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_VWAP_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Morning gaps that open significantly below the prior close and below VWAP often revert toward VWAP as institutional liquidity fills the imbalance, creating a long bias. This strategy fades the gap by waiting for VWAP reclamation on a 5-minute bar, distinct from gap-continuation strategies that trade in the gap's direction.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** If SPY gaps down >0.3% from prior close at market open AND the opening price is below VWAP, monitor 5-minute bars. Enter long at the close of the first 5-minute bar that closes above VWAP.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the low of the gap bar (the opening 5-minute bar). Take profit 1 at 1.5R (risk-reward based on entry to stop). Runner position uses a Chandelier trail (multiple of ATR) for the remaining position. Only active during first 60 minutes of trading and when VIX >16. Avoid entries if price is >0.5% above VWAP at open (to avoid bullish gaps/uptrends).
